description: Full one-call report on NEET (Solana, canonical mint Ce2gx9KGXJ6C9Mp5b5x1sn9Mg87JwEbrQby4Zqo3pump) for agents acting for NEET holders. Sections, each with its source named: canonical identity verification (registry), market block (price, 24h change, market cap, liquidity, volume — DexScreener), safety summary (RugCheck score, flagged risks, LP lock), cluster and consensus state (are tracked smart-money wallets converging on NEET in the last 24h: consensus score, STRONG / FORMING / QUIET / EXITING signal, tracked buyer and seller counts, net flow, coverage), buying-pressure headline (net inflow needed for 2x / 5x / 10x from live pool reserves, constant-product math), holder-health headline (percent of sampled wallets in profit, total unrealized PnL, weighted average cost, MVRV, sample coverage), and recent CLONE sightings: other Solana mints trading on the NEET name, each marked CLONE with the canonical contract named. Sections degrade independently and honestly: a failed source is named in data_gaps and never blocks the rest. Independent tooling, not affiliated with the NEET token or its team; data only, no predictions or recommendations. Cost: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (Base settlement; Solana settlement when configured) — no API key needed.
name: neet_report
